name: bottle_basket
task: Put the bottle in the brown basket
scene: sim bottle_basket (robots/rebot_b601_sim/easy_tasks.py BottleBasketScorer); the twin basket tasks reuse this ladder through basket.json
script: move the bottle to the brown basket
release the bottle in the brown basket

subtasks.criterion: gripper open and moving toward the bottle; no finger touches it; bottle upright at its start spot
fingers closing on the bottle body from the side; bottle still resting on the table
bottle held between both fingers and clear of the table, still near its start spot

subtasks.text: carry the bottle to the basket
subtasks.criterion: bottle held and travelling toward or hovering above the basket

subtasks.text: place the bottle in the basket
subtasks.criterion: bottle lowered inside the basket rim; fingers opening or just opened
gripper empty, bottle resting inside the basket, arm moving away or back to its home pose
arm not moving for the whole strip, or doing something none of the entries above describes (bottle knocked over, gripper empty away from both objects)

stages.name: reach
stages.criterion: finger midpoint within about 6 cm of the bottle

stages.name: held
stages.criterion: both fingers in contact with the bottle

stages.name: lifted
stages.criterion: held and the bottle more than 3 cm above where it rested

stages.name: over
stages.criterion: lifted and the bottle above the basket footprint

stages.name: inside
stages.criterion: bottle inside the basket, below the rim, no finger touching it
